title: Launch Campaign Runner
subtitle: From one brief it sends the launch email, the launch text message and WhatsApp template, posts on X and the Facebook Page, cross-posts to other channels, pins the announcement and opens a payment link.
lede: From one brief it sends the launch email, the launch text message and WhatsApp template, posts on X and the Facebook Page, cross-posts to other channels, pins the announcement and opens a payment link. It then reports the response across all of them.
who: a founder or marketing lead with a product launch
author: Corey James
